raw: {"analysis": "RJM provides a more detailed and actionable plan, explicitly addressing the costly CI pipeline by suggesting to avoid full runs for every commit and reserving them for final PR and merge. It also includes a rigorous flaky test handling procedure (reproduce on previous release) and a dedicated lane for downstream impact analysis, which is critical for confirming no disruptions. MBT is solid but less specific on CI cost optimization and flaky test verification, and its downstream adaptation lane is less focused on verification. Overall, RJM is more thorough and reduces follow-up questions.", "verdict": "RJM"}
